text: Sorry, I know you must be busy. My girl's 6 and her temp's just come up at 39.9, which is the highest she's ever had and it's thrown me a bit. She's got a streaming nose and keeps sneezing. I've had a good look all over her for any rash because I know that's what you're meant to check, and there's nothing, no spots anywhere. Sorry if this is a silly one, I just didn't know if that number on its own is something to worry about
